**Feedback (based on my review of the sites):**

**Dora – www.dora-website.com**  
- The site has a clean, personal feel and clearly shows your e‑mail (`dora@securemail‑hub.com`) and work account (`dora.work@securemail‑hub.com`).  
- **Suggestion:** Consider adding a brief “About/Projects” section that highlights your recent work, portfolio pieces, or any open‑source contributions. This will give visitors a quicker sense of your professional focus and make the site even more engaging.  
- Keep the personal touches (photos, interests) – they help humanize the site and make it memorable.

**Eve
